options.question: What do I get with Premium?

reply:
Premium gives you access to the #premium-lounge and #portfolio-reviews channels, one live portfolio review a month in the Thursday review call, early access to new asset packs two weeks before everyone else, and a Premium role colour. Everything in the free channels stays free.

-# Sources: Membership > What Premium includes (membership.md)

options.question: How much is Premium, and how do I pay for it?

reply:
Premium costs 9 US dollars a month or 90 US dollars a year. To pay, run /premium and the bot will give you a checkout link. The link is tied to your Discord account, so the Premium role arrives by itself within a minute of paying. You don't need to send a receipt to a moderator.

-# Sources: Membership > Price and billing (membership.md)

options.question: Can I get my money back if I bought the yearly plan last week?

reply:
Yes, yearly plans can be refunded within 14 days of payment, so a purchase from last week should still qualify. To request it, open a /ticket and ask for a refund.

-# Sources: FAQ > Refunds (faq.md)
